info.title: API.SH: Brastemp
info.description: The Brastemp API from API.SH: public Brastemp data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
What the Brastemp search box suggests while typing: suggested searches with their search counts and the category they lead to, plus up to 5 matching products with price and image. Without `query`, the store's top searches.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/brastemp-autocomplete

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The words typed so far (optional; empty returns the top searches).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The filters (facets) the Brastemp store offers for a search or category, with the number of products behind each value: department, category, subcategory, brand, price ranges, voltage, colour, capacity and the rest. Each value carries a `filter` string to pass to `/brastemp/v1/search` as `filters` (price ranges carry `min_price`/`max_price`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/brastemp-filters

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search words. Optional when `category`, `collection` or `filters` is given.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category path from `/brastemp/v1/categories` (department/category/subcategory), e.g. `eletrodomesticos`, `eletrodomesticos/geladeira---refrigerador`, or a store category link.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Facet filters as key:value pairs from `/brastemp/v1/filters` (the `filter` field of each value), comma separated, e.g. `voltagem:220v`.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: A collection id (digits) from a product's `collections` (offers, campaigns, launches).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One product of the Brastemp store with every variant (SKU, often 127 V and 220 V): model code, EAN, price, list price, cash price, stock, installment plans per card brand, sellers, promotions, images and videos; plus the description, every specification (dimensions, capacity, energy rating, warranty...), specification groups, collections, categories and `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/brastemp-product

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: A store link such as `https://brastemp.com.br/geladeira-frost-free-french-door-3-portas-branca-brastemp-bro85mb/p`, its slug, a product id (digits), a model code such as `BRO85MB` or an EAN (13 digits). One of `product`, `sku` or `model` is required.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: A SKU id (digits) from a product's `variants`.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: A model code (the store's reference), e.g. `BRO85MB`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of a Brastemp product: rating, text, recommendation, verified purchase, author's first name and initial, date, helpful votes, photos and the store's reply; plus the average rating, the 1-5 star breakdown, the recommendation rate and the counts of reviews with text and photos. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/brastemp-reviews

get.description:
Search the official Brastemp online store (brastemp.com.br): refrigerators, washing machines, stoves, ovens, dishwashers, air conditioners, water purifiers and the rest of the range, by keyword and/or category, with every filter the store offers (voltage, colour, capacity, type, features and the rest from `/brastemp/v1/filters`), a price range, a collection and the store's sorts. Each product comes with its price range, list price, cash price, best interest-free installment plan, availability, categories, highlights, variant options and every variant (SKU) with model code, EAN, voltage/colour, price, list price, stock, installments per card brand, sellers and images, plus the specifications and `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/brastemp-search

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search words in Portuguese or a model code, e.g. `geladeira`, `lava e seca`, `BRO85MB`. Optional when `category`, `collection`, `filters` or a price range is given.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category path from `/brastemp/v1/categories` (department/category/subcategory), e.g. `eletrodomesticos`, `eletrodomesticos/geladeira---refrigerador`, or a store category link.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Facet filters as key:value pairs from `/brastemp/v1/filters` (the `filter` field of each value), comma separated, e.g. `voltagem:220v`.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: A collection id (digits) from a product's `collections` (offers, campaigns, launches).

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price in reais.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price in reais.

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: `1` to leave out products that are out of stock.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-200).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page (1-50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Delivery options for a product to a Brazilian CEP, as the Brastemp store's checkout quotes them: each option's name, price, estimated business days and date, carrier and pickup points, plus the item's price at checkout and availability for that address. Pass a `sku`, or a `product` (its first available variant is quoted).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/brastemp-shipping

parameters.name: cep
parameters.description: The destination CEP (8 digits, with or without the dash).

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: A SKU id (digits) from a product's `variants`.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: A store link such as `https://brastemp.com.br/geladeira-frost-free-french-door-3-portas-branca-brastemp-bro85mb/p`, its slug, a product id (digits), a model code such as `BRO85MB` or an EAN (13 digits). One of `product`, `sku` or `model` is required.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: A model code (the store's reference), e.g. `BRO85MB`.

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description: A seller id from the variant's `sellers` (optional; by default the seller that has the item in stock).

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: Units (1-10).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/brastemp-store-reviews

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page (1-50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
